metadata.description: Confrontation naming test: given a functional description, select the correct word among intra-category distractors. Unlike R1 (inter-category distractors like 'color' vs 'tool'), distractors here are ALL from the same semantic category, making the task harder and more clinically relevant.
references: Howard & Patterson (1992) Pyramids and Palm Trees
